display_name: Order to Cash - Customer Deductions and Disputes
description: A retailer short-pays an invoice and cites a reason. The workflow decides whether the deduction is valid (issue credit) or invalid (dispute and rebill), and routes judgment calls to an analyst.

pricing_discrepancy.label: Pricing discrepancy
pricing_discrepancy.on_valid: Accept: issue credit memo for the price difference
pricing_discrepancy.on_invalid: Dispute: rebill with contract price evidence
pricing_discrepancy.policy_query: price discrepancy contract price invoice price credit memo

promotion_allowance.label: Promotion or trade allowance
promotion_allowance.on_valid: Accept: match to trade promotion accrual and close
promotion_allowance.on_invalid: Dispute: request proof of performance or deny against agreement
promotion_allowance.policy_query: promotion trade allowance agreement proof of performance accrual

shortage.label: Shortage
shortage.on_valid: Accept: credit shortage confirmed on proof of delivery
shortage.on_invalid: Dispute: signed proof of delivery shows full quantity
shortage.policy_query: shortage proof of delivery signed quantity received

damaged_goods.label: Damaged goods
damaged_goods.on_valid: Accept: credit damage and file carrier claim
damaged_goods.on_invalid: Dispute: claim outside window or without evidence
damaged_goods.policy_query: damaged goods claim window photo evidence carrier

compliance_chargeback.label: Compliance chargeback
compliance_chargeback.on_valid: Accept: chargeback valid under retailer routing guide
compliance_chargeback.on_invalid: Dispute: carrier or retailer caused the violation
compliance_chargeback.policy_query: compliance chargeback routing guide asn late delivery labeling fault
